summary: Persistent request list (one holder, idle level) drained by esv::inventory::MemberUnloadSystem (factory bg3.exe+0x2378A90 names the system; Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xF59900 MemberUnloadSystem::Update, InventoryMemberUnloadSystem.cpp). Members removed from an inventory that cannot be placed in a level are logged ('Inventory member %s could not be placed in a valid level...') and passed as Span<EntityHandle> to EntityManager::UnloadLocalEntities. Its sibling FailedAddsUnloadRequestComponent is handled the same way.

fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: Adder bg3.exe+0x348B190 zeroes ptr/capacity/size (Array shape); destructor bg3.exe+0x686280 frees a trivially-destructible array. Toolkit MemberUnloadSystem::Update walks ptr .. ptr+size*8, logs each element as an entity and hands the range to EntityManager::UnloadLocalEntities(Span<ID<EntityHandleTraits> const>). Live: empty.
